title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: Use Case 1 requires every category to be recorded on both the check-run output and logs, and its postcondition says every category was considered, but AC1 explicitly permits a terminally failing pass to reach only some categories and, before review publication, record them in logs only. Condition these use-case requirements on completed review execution and reflect the two terminal-failure surfaces so the normative sections do not contradict each other.
